## Biography & Summary
Monojit Goswami (MG) is a self-taught Backend and AIML Engineer specializing in production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, agentic AI, and high-performance ML pipelines built with Python, FastAPI, and modern LLM stacks. He focuses on scalable server architecture, low-latency streaming responses, vector search databases, and enterprise-grade tenant isolation.

## Technical Proficiencies
- **Programming Languages**: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, C, C++, SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL)
- **AI & LLM Ecosystem**: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI Workflows, LangChain, Pinecone, ChromaDB, Gemini APIs, Groq, Transformers, Embedding Models
- **Backend & Distributed Systems**: FastAPI, Node.js, Server-Sent Events (SSE), RESTful APIs, Redis, Supabase, Google Cloud Firestore, Firebase
- **Frontend & UI Engineering**: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lenis Smooth Scroll
- **Operating Systems & Tooling**: Arch Linux, Hyprland, Git, Docker, VS Code, Kitty, Fish Shell

## Projects Showcase

### 1. Shiksha Saathi
- **Summary**: A production-grade RAG-based SaaS chatbot providing 24x7 student support for college-specific academic information.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, FastAPI, Firestore, Transformers, Gemini API, Pinecone, Dropbox, Vercel, HTML/CSS, Vanilla JS
- **Repository**: https://github.com/monojitgoswami69/Shiksha_Saathi
- **Key Features**: Real-time knowledge base management, dynamic system prompt control via admin panel, confidence-threshold based human handoff to prevent hallucinations, analytics dashboard for high-confusion and unresolved queries.

### 2. Campus Dost
- **Summary**: A multi-tenant SaaS evolution of Shiksha Saathi, providing isolated RAG chatbot instances for multiple educational institutions.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, FastAPI, Firestore, Gemini Embeddings, Gemini/Groq API, Firebase Auth, Pinecone, Dropbox, Vercel, React JS
- **Repository**: https://github.com/monojitgoswami69/campus-dost
- **Key Features**: Strict tenant isolation, per-institute vector store separation, multi-role RBAC admin system, centralized infrastructure and scaling.

### 3. Codalyzer
- **Summary**: An LLM-powered static code analysis tool that infers time and space complexity and suggests optimizations.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, FastAPI, React, LLM API
